description: This file contains utility functions for processing and sanitizing assistant messages, including stripping XML tags, model tokens, tool call texts, and reasoning tags, as well as extracting and formatting assistant message content.

methods.name: isAssistantMessage
methods.description: Type guard to check if a message is an AssistantMessage based on role.

methods.name: stripMinimaxToolCallXml
methods.description: Removes malformed Minimax tool invocation XML tags from text.

methods.name: stripModelSpecialTokens
methods.description: Removes internal model control tokens like <|assistant|> from text.

methods.name: stripDowngradedToolCallText
methods.description: Removes downgraded tool call representations and historical context markers from text.

methods.name: stripThinkingTagsFromText
methods.description: Removes thinking tags and their content from text.

methods.name: extractAssistantText
methods.description: Extracts sanitized assistant message content, removing tags and tokens.

methods.name: extractAssistantThinking
methods.description: Extracts thinking content from assistant message blocks.

methods.name: formatReasoningMessage
methods.description: Formats reasoning text with markdown italics and a prefix.

methods.name: splitThinkingTaggedText
methods.description: Splits text into thinking and non-thinking parts based on tags.

methods.name: promoteThinkingTagsToBlocks
methods.description: Converts inline thinking tags into structured thinking blocks.

methods.name: extractThinkingFromTaggedText
methods.description: Extracts thinking content from tagged text.

methods.name: extractThinkingFromTaggedStream
methods.description: Extracts thinking content from a stream of tagged text, considering open/close tags.

methods.name: inferToolMetaFromArgs
methods.description: Generates tool metadata string from tool name and arguments.
